text_block_list.text:
Cleanup time after training.
Students all around are diligently sweeping and tidying up.
choice_data_list: (That feels so nice and refreshing... Hm?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaah, guess this is good enough~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: There's so much stuff here, sweeping all the way to the back looks tough... Besides, nobody's gonna look in a place like this anywayââ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, uh~ that's not it.
It's just a bit dusty,
so I was wondering what to do about it~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, so... It's not like I'm slacking off or anything~...
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. I don't think of it that way at all.

text_block_list.text:
The floor is pretty clean. Nothing special, but nothing wrong with it either.
It's been cleaned properly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
You're right, ehehe.
However, just as she mentioned earlier, dust has begun to gather a bit in the deeper sections.

Cleaning up is definitely for the best.
Thinking she ought to give it a shot...
choice_data_list: Why not show some real grit while you're at it?
Giving cleaning your all might build your stamina.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, this much is plenty~.
It's not like today's spring cleaning day, after all...
choice_data_list: Even though you're so good at cleaning...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I'm good at it...?
I was just sweeping normally, though...
choice_data_list: I want to see you give it your all!
I want to see you give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~? I mean, if I got totally serious, I'm sure it'd end up sparkling clean, but~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well... If you insist that much,
maybe I'll give it a shot just for today?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's that supposed to mean~?
You sure are in good spirits.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll go give it my all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes, her stamina...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: True, repeatedly squatting and standing up does use quite a bit of muscle... doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Right, right, it'll make for great training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... That might actually kill two birds with one stone.
choice_data_list: Doing good deeds puts you in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~ Thinking about it that way,
doing it properly seems like a much better deal, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, that might be better than dragging things out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll try for once. Hip, hip, hooray~.
